title: Hardware Sentinel: Protecting Software Applications from Hardware Silent Data Corruptions
problem: Silent Data Corruptions (SDCs) caused by silicon defects in CPUs propagate undetected through large-scale data center applications, causing unpredictable failures (segfaults, crashes, log anomalies) that are difficult to attribute to hardware without systematic cross-layer analysis.
motivation: As chips scale in transistor density and fleet size grows into millions of nodes, silicon defect rates and SDC incidence increase, making reliable detection critical to meet service-level objectives in production cloud infrastructure.
method: Hardware Sentinel connects software failures—like crashes and error logs—to underlying CPU defects by analyzing patterns in application behavior. It builds statistical models (mathematical patterns showing how failures relate to specific CPUs) that enable engineers to identify which machines have hardware-caused errors. This approach was validated using 6 years of real production data spanning 13 workloads across 27 data center regions, combining fleet-wide monitoring with both in-production hardware tests (Ripple) and dedicated offline tests (Fleetscanner).
key_novelty: It detects faulty CPUs by observing application failures rather than running specialized hardware tests, finding problems that traditional testing methods miss.
contributions: Hardware Sentinel framework correlating software failure indicators (segfaults, crashes, logs) to SDC-inducing CPU defects.
1.74x coverage improvement over Fleetscanner (out-of-production) and 1.92x over Ripple (in-production) hardware testing.
Identification of hundreds of defective CPUs across 7 CPU generations from multiple manufacturers over 6 years of production data.
Characterization of top kernel exceptions most correlated with SDC failures across 13 workloads and 27 regions.

metrics.other: SDC detection coverage: 1.74x over Fleetscanner, 1.92x over Ripple

limitations: The framework relies on statistical correlation between application failures and hardware defects, so it may miss SDCs that do not manifest as observable software failures.
primary_theme: software-driven silent data corruption detection in production fleets
